title: Cross-phase dependency 'nature' fields should hint at contract structure for bootstrap
description: Pipeline message schemas and OpenSearch document schema (IP-13, 29 downstream dependents) are described informally in cross-phase dep 'nature' fields. Bootstrap needs these to define formal contracts but the current descriptions don't provide enough structure.
root_cause: The cross-phase dependency table's 'Nature' column is free-text. It describes what the dependency is for but doesn't hint at the contract type (message schema, API contract, shared model, etc.) that bootstrap should create.
recommendation: In Phase 3.3, when generating the Cross-Phase Dependencies table, add a 'Contract Type' column or structured nature field: one of {message_schema, api_contract, shared_model, opensearch_schema, config_contract}. This gives bootstrap a head start on contract definition.
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Cross-Phase Dependencies table
